meta.name: LFP Atlas
meta.cite: LFP Atlas v0.3.0 — global LFP/LMFP cathode synthesis-route and producer census. CC-BY 4.0, attribution 'LFP Atlas' + version. Companion to NMC Atlas; both fold into Cathodes ATLAS.
key_findings: •  ONE route dominates ~all commercial LFP tonnage: high-temperature solid-state CARBOTHERMAL REDUCTION fed by a (co-precipitated) FePO4 precursor  ->  spray-dried with Li source + carbon  ->  calcined under inert gas. These are linked STAGES of one workflow, not competing methods.
•  The only other route at meaningful commercial tonnage is Shenzhen Dynanonic's proprietary LIQUID-PHASE process (SELPS, auto-thermal evaporative; patent US20140239235A1).

•  HYDROTHERMAL is a smaller/legacy commercial route (historically Sud-Chemie; today premium LMFP e.g. Taiheiyo 'Nanolitia'). Everything else is lab-scale, with melt-casting and spray pyrolysis demonstrated at pilot.
•  China makes ~95-98% of global LFP CAM. 2024 leader: Hunan Yuneng (~28.8% share); 2025 Yuneng shipments >1 Mt. LMFP is ramping, led by Hengchuang Nano + Ronbay.
•  Correction to a common assumption: Aleees (Taiwan) uses an in-house iron-phosphate PRECURSOR route (+ solid-state), NOT hydrothermal.

•  Western/Indian production became possible largely after key foundational LFP patents expired (~2022-2023). Many Western projects are announced/pre-production and volatile (e.g. ICL's US plant was cancelled in Nov 2025).

Upper = headline + bundles and unsplit-cathode figures. Announced / planned / construction claims form a separate PIPELINE total; targets count toward nothing. methods.name: Conventional solid-state reaction
methods.how: Dry-mix Li/Fe/P powders, grind, calcine 600-800C under inert gas
methods.dis: Large/irregular particles, long firing, poor morphology control
methods.ref: Padhi, Nanjundaswamy & Goodenough 1997, J. Electrochem. Soc. 144:1188

methods.name: Carbothermal reduction (CTR)
methods.how: Solid-state variant; carbon reduces Fe3+->Fe2+ (C->CO) during firing + in-situ carbon coat
methods.adv: Uses cheap Fe3+ (FePO4/Fe2O3); reduction + coating in one step; industrial workhorse
methods.dis: High T; atmosphere & carbon control; grain growth
methods.producers_text: Hunan Yuneng, Hubei Wanrun, BYD, Gotion, most producers
methods.ref: Lu & Zhu 2024, MRS Communications 14:888; Wang et al. 2008 J. Power Sources

methods.name: Mechanochemical / high-energy ball milling
methods.how: High-energy milling activates/reacts precursors near RT; usually + calcination
methods.adv: Fine mixing, small particles, defect activation
methods.dis: Media contamination, energy-intensive; rarely full synthesis alone
methods.producers_text: Universal as a commercial MIXING step
methods.ref: Kim et al. 2007, J. Power Sources 166:211

methods.name: Microwave-assisted solid-state
methods.how: Microwave heating of dry precursors for rapid calcination
methods.ref: Guo, Zhan & Zhou 2009, Solid State Ionics 180:386

methods.name: Molten-salt (flux) synthesis
methods.how: React precursors inside a low-melting salt flux (KCl/LiCl); salt washed out
methods.ref: Zhu et al. 2012, Electrochimica Acta (KCl flux LFP/C)

methods.name: Molten-state synthesis (melt casting)
methods.how: Melt precursors (~1000-1150C) to an ingot, crush/mill, carbon-coat
methods.adv: Cheapest coarse Fe; melts in minutes; no liquid waste; big batches
methods.dis: Very high T; hard to nano-size; energy-heavy grinding
methods.ref: Patience et al. 2019, Can. J. Chem. Eng. (melt-synthesis pilot)

methods.name: FePO4-precursor route (precipitation -> carbothermal)
methods.how: Precipitate FePO4.xH2O (FeSO4 + phosphate), mix w/ Li + carbon, carbothermal calcine
methods.adv: Cheapest Fe (FeSO4 by-product); atomic Fe:P mixing; THE Chinese industrial route
methods.producers_text: Hunan Yuneng, Wanrun, Lopal, Aleees, most Chinese CAM
methods.ref: Lu & Zhu 2024, MRS Communications 14:888; Nekahi et al. 2024, Mater. Sci. Eng. R 159:100797

methods.name: Co-precipitation
methods.how: Precipitate mixed metal-phosphate/oxalate from solution, pH-adjust, dry, calcine
methods.adv: Atomic mixing; uniform composition; key LMFP route; scalable
methods.ref: Omidi, Babaei & Ataie 2020, Mater. Res. Bull. 125:110807 (via Lu & Zhu 2024 review; link -> review)

methods.name: Liquid-phase auto-thermal evaporative (SELPS)
methods.how: Accelerant drives a self-heating (auto-thermal) reaction that evaporates solvent to a solid precursor
methods.adv: Proprietary; #2 commercial route by tonnage; nano product
methods.ref: Patent US20140239235A1 (assignee: Shenzhen Dynanonic)

methods.name: Sol-gel
methods.how: Chelate precursors (e.g. citric acid) -> gel, dry, calcine
methods.adv: Molecular mixing; small pure particles; no autoclave
methods.producers_text: Research; Dynanonic uses sol-gel for some LMFP
methods.ref: Hu, Doeff et al. 2004, J. Electrochem. Soc. 151:A1279

methods.name: Hydrothermal
methods.how: Crystallize LFP directly from aqueous solution in autoclave, 120-220C
methods.dis: Fe antisite defects (<150C); autoclaves; wastewater; costlier than solid-state
methods.ref: Yang, Zavalij & Whittingham 2001, Electrochem. Commun. 3:505

methods.name: Solvothermal
methods.how: As hydrothermal but organic solvent (e.g. ethylene glycol) as medium/reductant
methods.ref: Li et al. 2021, Small Methods (solvothermal LFP)

methods.name: Supercritical-fluid (supercritical hydrothermal)
methods.how: Nucleate LFP in supercritical water (>374C, >22 MPa), often continuous
methods.ref: Zhang et al. 2020 review, Ceram. Int. (cites Xu, Lee & Teja 2008, J. Supercrit. Fluids 44:92)

methods.name: Polyol
methods.how: Reflux precursors in polyol (~320C) acting as solvent + reductant
methods.adv: No autoclave; no inert gas needed; nano particles
methods.ref: Kim et al. 2012, J. Power Sources (polyol LFP)

methods.name: Emulsion drying
methods.how: Emulsify aqueous precursors in oil, dry, calcine -> C-LFP
methods.ref: Cho & Chung 2004, J. Power Sources 133:272

methods.name: Freeze drying (lyophilization)
methods.how: Freeze precursor solution, sublimate -> porous precursor, calcine
methods.ref: Zhang et al. 2024, Batteries 10:114 (freeze-dry LMFP)

methods.name: Combustion / self-propagating (solution combustion)
methods.how: Ignite fuel (glycine/urea) + nitrate solution; self-sustaining exothermic reaction
methods.dis: Gas release; phase-purity control; usually post-calcine
methods.ref: Hsieh et al. 2009, J. Power Sources (glycine combustion LFP/C)

methods.name: Rheological-phase
methods.how: React a solid-liquid paste (rheological body) of precursors, then calcine
methods.ref: Xie et al. 2009, Electrochimica Acta (rheological-phase LFP/C)

methods.name: Ionothermal
methods.how: Synthesize in an ionic liquid as solvent/template (lower T, ~ambient P)
methods.ref: Recham, Armand, Tarascon et al. 2009, Chem. Mater. 21:1096

methods.name: Spray pyrolysis
methods.how: Atomize precursor into hot zone; droplet -> spherical particle in seconds; + heat-treat
methods.dis: High T; equipment; often needs post-anneal
methods.producers_text: Scale-up demonstrated; not a commercial tonnage route
methods.ref: Akao, Yamada, Ogihara & Kodera 2010, Int. J. Chem. Eng. 2010:175914

methods.name: Spray drying (+ calcination)
methods.how: Atomize ball-milled slurry -> spherical secondary particles; then calcine
methods.adv: Excellent tap density/flow; spherical secondaries; industry-standard granulation
methods.producers_text: Standard step on commercial LFP/LMFP lines
methods.ref: Lu & Zhu 2024, MRS Communications 14:888; Chen et al. 2015, Electrochim. Acta 186:117

methods.name: Ultrasonic spray pyrolysis
methods.how: Ultrasonic atomization -> finer uniform droplets -> nano C-LFP
methods.ref: Yang, Teng & Wu 2006, J. Power Sources 159:307

methods.name: Flame spray pyrolysis (FSP)
methods.how: Combust atomized precursor in a flame -> phosphate nanoparticles
methods.dis: Reducing-atmosphere control for Fe2+ hard; phase purity
methods.ref: Rudin, Wegner & Pratsinis 2011, J. Nanopart. Res. 13:2715

methods.name: Template-assisted
methods.how: Hard/soft templates impose porosity/morphology; template removed
methods.ref: Yu et al. 2009, J. Power Sources (template mesoporous LFP/C)

methods.name: Microwave-hydrothermal
methods.how: Hydrothermal crystallization driven by microwave heating (minutes)
methods.ref: Zhu et al. 2021, J. Mater. Sci. (microwave-hydrothermal LFP)

methods.name: Electrospinning
methods.how: Electrospin polymer + precursor into nanofibers; pyrolyze -> LFP/C fiber mats
methods.ref: Zhu et al. 2012, J. Solid State Electrochem. (LFP nanofibers)

methods.name: Plasma (RF-ICP / microwave-plasma)
methods.how: Vaporize/quench precursors in thermal plasma -> nanospheres; can C-coat in one step
methods.producers_text: 6K Energy 'UniMelt' microwave-plasma (13 kt plant under construction, TN)
methods.ref: 6K Energy (PlusCAM, DOE grant) + Univ. de Sherbrooke thesis (RF-ICP LFP)

methods.name: One-Pot (Nano One proprietary)
methods.how: Single reactor: low-cost iron oxide/powder + phosphoric acid + Li; carbothermal; no separate sulfate/pCAM step; no wastewater
methods.adv: Fewer steps; no sodium-sulfate wastewater; cheap Fe feedstock
methods.producers_text: Nano One Materials (Candiac, Quebec, ~2,400 tpa nameplate)
methods.ref: Nano One / Natural Resources Canada (One-Pot LFP)

families.name: Solid-State (dry) family
families.defines: Dry powders reacted by calcination; no bulk solvent
families.includes: Conventional solid-state; carbothermal reduction (CTR); mechanochemical / ball-milling; microwave solid-state; molten-salt (flux)
families.relevance: DOMINANT. CTR (via FePO4 precursor) = ~90% of global LFP tonnage.

families.name: Melt / Molten-State family
families.defines: Precursors melted to an ingot, then crushed
families.relevance: Pilot / historical-commercial (Phostech; JM pilot). Largely superseded.

families.name: Wet-Chemistry / Solution family
families.defines: Reaction in a liquid medium (aqueous / organic / ionic liquid)
families.includes: FePO4-precursor precipitation; co-precipitation; liquid-phase SELPS; sol-gel; hydrothermal; solvothermal; supercritical; polyol; emulsion drying; freeze drying; combustion; rheological-phase; ionothermal
families.relevance: Commercial for the FePO4 precursor + LMFP co-precip + Dynanonic SELPS + hydrothermal (minor). Rest are lab.

families.name: Aerosol / Spray family
families.includes: Spray pyrolysis; spray drying (+ calcination); ultrasonic spray; flame spray
families.relevance: Spray DRYING is a standard commercial granulation step. Spray pyrolysis is lab/pilot.

families.name: Novel / Hybrid family
families.defines: Combine/modify the above, or use exotic energy
